title: Crestline Fleet Account Credit Memos and the Invoice Dispute Window
content:
A credit memo on a Crestline Fleet Account corrects one invoice. It reduces what is owed on that invoice for a return, a pricing correction, a resolved dispute or a duplicate invoice.

## Dispute window

An invoice dispute must be raised no later than the end of the dispute window counted from the invoice date of the disputed invoice. Calendar days are counted from the day after the anchor date, so the anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date. The window is the program's dispute window days, read against the invoice date recorded on the disputed invoice, and a dispute raised on the last qualifying date is within it. The window applies to pricing correction and dispute resolution credits; a return credit (from a refunded ticket) and a duplicate invoice credit are not limited by it.

## Kinds of credit

| Credit | Amount | Dispute window applies |
|---|---|---|
| pricing correction | see the retired clause and current basis below | yes |
| duplicate invoice | the full amount of the second of two invoices matching on vehicle, invoice date, service category and amount | no |
| dispute resolution | the disputed amount the business is found to be owed | yes |
| return (refunded ticket) | — | no |

> A pricing correction restores the program's fleet discount percent the invoice should have received.

This clause is **no longer in force** as an unqualified rule. The current basis reads: for a tire invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all, and only for such a tire invoice, the pricing correction credits what the tire pricing correction rule works out for the billing error, which is at least the fleet discount the ticket should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried, except that it never exceeds the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice, that limit prevailing; for a brake invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all, and only for such a brake invoice, the pricing correction credits what the brake pricing correction rule works out for the billing error, which is at least the fleet discount the brake jobs should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried, except that it never exceeds the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice, that limit prevailing; every other pricing correction remains under the clause above.

## Ceilings

- The credit never exceeds the amount still open on the invoice plus the payments already applied to it.
- Customer care may issue a credit up to the program's credit memo desk limit per invoice; a larger credit is decided by Crestline Fleet Credit.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, a program with a 45-day window)

| Invoice date | Dispute raised | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a month | 45 days after the 1st (the last qualifying date) | yes |
| the 1st of a month | 46 days after the 1st | no |

A hypothetical invoice of 300.00 with 200.00 paid and nothing else applied has 100.00 open; a credit on it can be at most 100.00 plus the 200.00 paid, that is 300.00.
